description: Core self-contained MCP package: refactor the API server and gateway to be importable, create the unified entry point (src/mcp.ts) that starts both in one process, create the CLI wrapper (src/cli.ts) with arg parsing, extend config.ts for policy/judge blocks in .warden.json, and update package.json for npm publishing. This is the critical deliverable. FEAT-002 depends on this being complete.
steps: 1. Refactor src/api/index.ts: Extract the server creation into an exported `startApiServer(port: number)` async function that calls `await initWarden()`, runs `Bun.serve({ port, routes: {...}, websocket: {...}, fetch(...){...} })`, and returns the server instance. Move ALL the existing route handlers, websocket config, and fetch handler inside this function. Add `export function broadcastEvent(event)` that publishes to the server. Wrap the existing top-level code in `if (import.meta.main) { ... }` so `bun run dev` (which runs `bun --hot src/api/index.ts`) still works exactly as before. The `if (import.meta.main)` block should: read PORT from env (default 3000), call startApiServer(PORT), and console.log the listening message. Also export a `stopApiServer()` function that calls `server.stop()` for graceful shutdown.

2. Refactor src/gateway/index.ts: Extract the gateway logic into an exported `startGateway(config: GatewayConfig)` async function. This function should accept a GatewayConfig, connect upstreams, vet tool descriptions, create the MCP Server, connect to StdioServerTransport, and return `{ server, upstreams }` for shutdown. Move the `log()` helper, `SESSION_ID`, `textOf()`, `Upstream` interface, `routes` map, `newClient()`, `connectHttp()`, `connectUpstream()`, `registerTools()`, and `vetToolDescriptions()` to module scope (they are already there). The new `startGateway(config)` does what `main()` does now but takes config as a parameter instead of calling `loadConfig()`. Wrap the existing bottom code in `if (import.meta.main) { const config = await loadConfig(); startGateway(config).catch(...) }` so standalone `bun src/gateway/index.ts` still works.

3. Extend src/gateway/config.ts: Add interfaces for the new config blocks: `PolicyConfig { failMode?, judgeMode?, thresholds?: { classifier?, similarity?, rules?, judge?, session?, highConfidence?, benignCertainty? } }` and `JudgeConfig { provider?, model?, apiKey?, baseUrl? }`. Extend GatewayConfig to include `policy?: PolicyConfig` and `judge?: JudgeConfig`. Update `loadConfig()` to also extract `parsed.policy` and `parsed.judge` from the JSON file. Add a new exported function `applyConfigToEnv(config: GatewayConfig)` that sets process.env values from the policy/judge blocks — e.g., config.policy.failMode -> WARDEN_FAIL_MODE, config.policy.judgeMode -> JUDGE_MODE, config.policy.thresholds.classifier -> CLASSIFIER_THRESHOLD, config.judge.provider/model -> JUDGE_PROVIDER/JUDGE_MODEL, etc. This function must be called BEFORE initWarden() so the env vars are in place when the policy loader reads them. Also update DEFAULT_PATH logic: try '.warden.json' first, fall back to 'warden-mcp.json', then fall back to WARDEN_MCP_CONFIG env var. When --config is explicitly passed, use only that path (no fallback). When no config file is found and no --config was explicit, do NOT throw — return an empty config `{ upstreams: {} }` so Warden can start in API-only mode or with --upstream-cmd args only.

4. Create src/mcp.ts: The self-contained orchestrator. Export an async function `startWarden(options: WardenOptions)` where WardenOptions = `{ mode: 'mcp' | 'api-only', port?: number, config?: GatewayConfig, upstreamCmds?: string[] }`. Implementation: (A) Redirect console.log to stderr: `const _origLog = console.log; console.log = (...args: unknown[]) => console.error(...args);` — this prevents model-loading messages from corrupting the MCP stdio stream. (B) If config has policy/judge blocks, call `applyConfigToEnv(config)` to set env vars. (C) Import and call `startApiServer(port ?? 0)` from src/api/index.ts. Read the actual port from `server.port`. (D) Set `process.env.WARDEN_URL = 'http://localhost:${actualPort}'`. (E) Log to stderr: `[warden] API server on port ${actualPort}`. (F) If mode is 'api-only', return { apiServer, port: actualPort }. (G) If mode is 'mcp': merge upstreamCmds into config.upstreams — each --upstream-cmd string is split by spaces into [command, ...args] and added with a generated name like 'upstream-1'. Then call `startGateway(mergedConfig)`. (H) Set up SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers that call gateway server close, then API server stop, then process.exit(0). (I) Return { apiServer, gateway, port: actualPort }.

5. Create src/cli.ts with shebang `#!/usr/bin/env bun`. Parse process.argv manually (no external deps): support `--help` (print usage to stderr, exit 0), `--upstream-cmd <cmd>` (repeatable, collects into string[]), `--config <path>` (path to .warden.json), `--api-only` (flag), `--port <n>` (number). Default port: 0 for MCP mode, 3000 for api-only. Load config from --config path or auto-discover .warden.json/warden-mcp.json. Call `startWarden()` from src/mcp.ts with the parsed options. The --help output should show: usage line, description ('Warden MCP security gateway'), all flags with descriptions, env vars section (OPENAI_API_KEY, WARDEN_FAIL_MODE, JUDGE_MODE, JUDGE_MODEL), and example Kiro/Claude Desktop config snippets. All output to stderr via console.error.

6. Update package.json: Change name to 'warden-mcp', keep version '0.1.0', remove 'private: true', add `"bin": { "warden-mcp": "./src/cli.ts" }`, add `"files": ["src/", "policies/", "dashboard/", "README.md"]`. Note: dashboard/ must be included because src/api/index.ts imports `dashboard/index.html`. Keep all existing scripts, dependencies, and devDependencies exactly as they are.
acceptance_criteria: src/api/index.ts exports startApiServer(port) and `bun run dev` still starts the API on port 3000
src/gateway/index.ts exports startGateway(config) and standalone `bun src/gateway/index.ts` still works
Running `bun src/cli.ts --help` prints usage to stderr and exits 0
Running `bun src/cli.ts --api-only --port 4444` starts the API server on port 4444
package.json has name 'warden-mcp', bin pointing to src/cli.ts, files array including src/, policies/, dashboard/, README.md
All existing tests pass: DB_PATH=./warden-test.db bun test
No console.log output reaches stdout in MCP mode (all redirected to stderr)
findings: All 316 existing tests pass. CLI --help prints to stderr and exits 0. console.log redirected to stderr in src/mcp.ts before any model imports. loadConfig() returns empty config when no file found (no throw). package.json updated: name=warden-mcp, bin, files array includes dashboard/.
